title: Legacy Cluster Routine Payload
description: Injection contract for the headless legacy-cluster routine. Describes exactly ONE pillar cluster (one hub + its explicit spokes) to rebuild into an existing brand's design system. One cluster per run — multiple clusters are rejected.

brand.description: The existing brand/design system to match. Must resolve to a demos/<brand>/ folder in the repo.

clusterName.description: Short slug used for the hub filename (<clusterName>.html), spoke filenames (<clusterName>-<spoke>.html), and provenance artifacts. Derived from the hub if omitted.

hub.description: Exactly one hub/pillar page URL to rebuild.

spokes.description: Explicit list of spoke page URLs. No crawling/auto-discovery. Must contain at least one spoke (a cluster is a hub plus spokes; for a lone page use the legacy-page-rebuild skill instead).

$comment: One cluster per run. The payload is a single object, NOT an array. A top-level array (multiple clusters/hubs) must be rejected by the routine before any build work.
